source_detail_limit: Published Fal FlashHead audio-to-video schema exposes image_url/audio_url/seed, output512x512at25fps. No native quality or resolution control.

offline_composition.scope: Offline exact saved first full avatar clip from Simon and Helenn; no generation; no tracked source edits.
offline_composition.method: Paired composition runs with reverse order second run; same 1080p25 compositor, CRF18 intermediate except CRF0 candidate; all final encode CRF22 medium threads2. CRF22 is controlled test, production defaults23.
offline_composition.warmup: Simon baseline first run4.015s is cold import/init; use warmed reverse pass for meaningful comparison.
offline_composition.sharpen: Native512 YCrCb luminance sigma0.7 amount0.3 delta clipped ±4; no invented features.
offline_composition.visual: Inspected six lip crops at1/2/3s over both faces (closed/open/smiling). Sharpen is subtly crisper but does not restore missing mouth/teeth detail; lossless has no material visible benefit. Motion comparison videos produced for parent visual review; no claim playback inspected.
offline_composition.recommendation: Reject both candidates: unproven meaningful quality gain, slower composition; lossless expands intermediate disk19–21x, sharpen increases final bytes4–8%.

offline_encoder.visual_result: CRF20/18 preserve slightly cleaner edges but no meaningful restoration of missing mouth/teeth detail; video-only samples are42-46%/78-86% larger thanCRF23. Do not promote this as a model-quality fix.
offline_encoder.timing_limit: Short local exploratory samples; not a full production latency benchmark.

next_pilot.approval: Declined: zero additional enhancement cost; no production-time increase permitted.

final_encoder_comparison.method: Two sequential reverse-order passes, exact same CRF18 wide source bytes as root; Simon4s120frames, Helenn6s180frames; fps30, threads2; baseline mediumCRF23 vsfastCRF20 vsveryfastCRF20. Offline no paid calls.
final_encoder_comparison.visualAssessment: Viewed all6 decoded lip samples at1/2/3s, covering closed/open/smile across both faces. No material facial detail recovery in either fasterCRF20 candidate; differences are minor encoding texture around already soft source.
final_encoder_comparison.recommendation: Neither satisfies all constraints: veryfast cuts isolated encode about68% but files grow13–24%; fast cuts11–14% and files grow43–52%. NewAPIcharges zero, but increased bytes increase transfer/storage burden; no measured end-to-end guarantee. No tracked code changes.

decision: Retain production defaults. User declined paid enhancement; tested faster/high-quality encode alternatives show no material lip detail recovery and increase transferred/stored bytes. No new production code or paid action.
